results.problem: asymptotic rank of complete graph tensor GT_2(K_n)
results.quote: Theorem 1.1 (complete graph tensors). For every integer \(n\ge 2\), over the complex numbers, \(\left\lfloor\frac{n^2}{4}\right\rfloor\le\mathrm{log}_2\widetilde{\text{R}}\big(\mathsf{G}\mathsf{T}_2(K_n)\big)\le\frac{n^2}{4}.\)

results.problem: asymptotic rank of even complete graph tensor GT_2(K_{2m})
results.quote: Corollary 4.12 (maximum-cut equality for even complete graphs). For every positive integer m, \(\mathrm{log}_2\widetilde{\text{R}}\big(\mathsf{GT}_2(K_{2m})\big)=\mathrm{MaxCut}(K_{2m})=m^2,\tau(K_{2m})=\frac{m}{2m-1}.\)

results.problem: edge exponent of complete graph tensor \tau(K_n)
results.quote: Corollary 4.13 (edge exponents below two thirds). For every integer \(n\ge 5\), \(\tau(K_n)\le\frac{n}{2(n-1)}<\frac{2}{3}.\)

results.problem: operational barrier for polynomial constructions on complete graph tensors
results.quote: Theorem 1.2 (barrier for the polynomial constructions). For every integer \(n\ge 3\) and every positive integer R, \(\mathbf{G}_{n,2}\unknown_{\mathrm{poly},n}\mathbf{I}_n(R)\Longrightarrow\mathrm{log}_2R\ge\frac{n^2}{4}.\)
